acceptance_signals: Preflight finds exactly one retained setuptools 84.0.0 wheel matching the previously recorded SHA-256 before any temporary root or build attempt.
Exactly one short task root stages committed distribution inputs plus the exact bounded current distribution overlay, and exactly one offline wheel-build attempt emits at most one wheel.

Before cleanup, durable sanitized evidence independently records exact shared-template wheel-member presence, the installed runtime's actual data scheme and normalized target, installed-file presence, and source-to-installed byte identity as pass, fail, or unknown.
The driver retains the verified short-root object while evidence is written, accepts only the bounded cleanup continuation, then removes the exact task-owned root and records the cleanup result.
Any preflight, build, install, member, scheme, presence, or digest deviation stops subsequent product-journey work without repair, retry, alternate artifact, or rehearsal v2.

STATUS.md and the dated development log state the exact bounded outcome, validation results, remaining unknowns, and denied authority without modifying product source, packaging declarations, tests, or the prior short-root implementation.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-4e715fe7fcac47549a79c3eef3e1f51e and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Using the validated short Windows build-root helper and the one already retained digest-matched setuptools 84.0.0 wheel, perform one exact-current-source offline wheel build and one fresh offline installation. Keep the task-owned wheel and runtime alive until a sanitized repository evidence record separately records exact wheel-member presence, actual runtime data scheme and normalized destination, installed-file presence, and source-to-installed byte identity. Then clean up the exact task root. Stop at the first deviation, do not repair any defect, and do not begin rehearsal v2.

items: A build or install deviation must stop the run without an in-task repair or second attempt.
The foreground driver temporarily retains a wheel and runtime; cleanup must use only the exact verified short-root object after evidence is durable.
The dirty worktree makes source-overlay expansion possible; only the exact distribution inputs used by the prior build protocol may be overlaid.
Sanitized evidence must omit absolute paths, process identifiers, raw command output, source content, prompts, responses, credentials, and session identities.

No product source or packaging modification, consumer fixture, external model, network request, credential access, Git mutation, commit, push, publication, release, deployment, or external write is authorized.
Reviewed assumption: Read-only preflight observed exactly one local setuptools 84.0.0 wheel with the previously recorded expected digest.
Reviewed assumption: The repository-internal short-root helper remains byte-identical to its validated implementation.
Reviewed assumption: The current dirty worktree can be reproduced from committed distribution inputs plus a deterministic exact overlay without copying unrelated runtime data.
Reviewed assumption: The current host can keep one foreground Python driver alive while the sanitized evidence is written before cleanup.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the new wheel contains the exact shared template member.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the fresh runtime contains the installed shared template at its actual scheme-derived destination.
Reviewed unknown: Whether source and installed template bytes match.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a deterministic packaging or installation defect will be observed.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a retained-artifact success would justify admitting rehearsal v2.
